rows.en: This time it's "Copper Ore," huh...
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, please wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
Hold on! There's something else here!?
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!?
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
No, wait! There's something else here!
Obtained "Broken O Raiser".
The O Raiser...!! To think it was here, of all places.
What's that thing?
It's something I need to stabilize my Twin Drive.
But it looks busted.
...First, let's head back to Maganac.
Go bring 00 here!
This is... MS equipment...?
This is... MS equipment...?
This is... MS equipment...?
This is... MS equipment...?
What's this...? Looks like MS equipment.
What's this...? Looks like MS equipment.
I wonder what this is... MS equipment, maybe?
What's this...? Looks like MS equipment.
What's this...? Looks like MS equipment.
I wonder what this is... Could it be MS equipment?
This is... MS equipment...?
What the hell's this...? Some kinda MS gear?
This equipment... Is it from an MS!?
This equipment... Is it from an MS!?
In that case, let's take it to Maganac and have him look into it.
It seems you succeeded in defeating the Crazygons.
{8074} and the team handed over the item they had obtained from the Crazygons.
This is... the "O Raiser"...!!
So the enemy was trying to get their hands on this!! ...I'm glad you got it back.
Yeah. But it's broken. It can't be used as it is.
We'll hold onto it for a while. We'll repair it with Celestial Being's technology.
Please do.
It's an item tied to 00. What's the use if he isn't here himself?
What on earth is this?
It's equipment made exclusively for 00.
It stabilizes the Twin Drive and draws out 00's abilities to the fullest.
Interesting. Let's give it to 00 right away.
However, it seems to be a little damaged.
We'll hold onto it for a while. We'll repair it with Celestial Being's technology.
Right.
00 must be in the party to progress this quest.
Completed the quest "Crazygon Hunt".
An Antlar nest has appeared in Desert Cube's Ruins Zone. Please exterminate it at once.
I'm sure you've heard already, but an Antlar nest has appeared.
So we just gotta crush it, right?
If that were all, it would be fine, but this time one of our comrades was dragged into the nest.
That's terrible!! We must go at once!! Leave it to us!!
That's terrible!! We must go at once!! Leave it to us!!
That's terrible!! We must go at once!! Leave it to us!!
That's terrible... Let's go right away! We'll do our best to rescue them!!
Now that's bad news! We'll take care of it for ya!
Mission accepted. We'll take care of it.
Understood. We'll take care of it.
That's terrible! We'll hurry to the rescue.
That's terrible! We'll hurry to the rescue.
What did you say!? All right, I'll take care of it!
What!? We'll hurry to the rescue.
That's terrible!! Leave it to us!!
That ain't good!! All right! Leave it to us!!
That's bad news! This ain't the time to sit around! Let's hurry!!
That's terrible! We've gotta hurry!! Ankh! Let's go!
We're counting on you. I'll mark the location on your map.
So that's it...!!
So that's it...!!
So that's it...!!
So that's it...!!

notes.note: Speakers verified in Quest008.bla (QuestEventMess008 = same text; MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N plays row N+1, empty rows 114/116/140/150 skipped without shifting, content confirms). Event005: +93 Crazygon (CHARA_NAME 97) -> 94; +97 Ankh (36) -> 98; +98+pt leader block -> 99-113; OkWin +114 -> 115; +116..+120 alternate 00 (10) / Ankh -> 117-121.

Leader block 99-113 = TextIdOffset+98+pt, same Pt_Chara_Check order as 43-57/64-78 in quest_007: Seven, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, 00, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Nu (default). Wording matches: 101 Mebius polite, 104 OOO casual. 'Iya' read as contradicting Ankh's disappointment (not the target yet). Identical Japanese kept identical; 106 differs only by '!?'.

OkWin. Item name 'Broken O Raiser' built like 'Broken Zeroliner Drill'/'Broken Bit'; 'O Raiser' from QuestMess/SkillName. (Prompt mentioned 'Planate Defenser' - that item belongs to quest 7 and does not occur in this slice.)
'Twin Drive' = glossary 'Twin Drive System', shortened in 00's own speech ('my Twin Drive').
Unreferenced (the no-00 path shows only OkWin +164). Speaker not recovered; rough imperative like the unreferenced Ankh-style rows 81/91 in quest_007.

Rows 126-139 (14-row block) and 141 are unreferenced by Quest008.bla. Likely an earlier design where a non-00 leader finds the O Raiser and doesn't recognise it; 14 rows = the leader list minus 00. Voiced from wording only (132/135 gentle, 137 rough Momotaros-style, 138/139 earnest). 141 speaker unknown; Maganac g=m -> 'him'.

Event002 (report): Maganac (79) +145 -> 146, narration +146 -> 147, Maganac +147/+148 -> 148/149, 00 +150 -> 151, Maganac +151 -> 152, 00 +152 -> 153, then OkWin +165 -> 166. 'Crazygons' plural as in quest_007 rows 6/9.
Maganac (still under his name box). 'Dakan dekite yokatta' - subject restored as the party ('you got it back'), since they brought it in.
00 to Maganac: 'tanomu' = 00 asking Maganac to repair it -> 'Please do.'

Rows 155 and 158-164 are unreferenced (alternate hand-over scene). Speakers inferred: 159/160/162/163 Maganac (polite, CB repair); 155/158/161/164 a party member, voiced neutral. 163 = 152 minus a comma, same English. 164 reuses the corpus 'Right.'
OkWin +164 (no-00 path); format follows quest_007 row 116. 166 = OkWin +165; quest title from QuestMess#0.9 'Crazygon Hunt'.
Quest 9 description row (no speaker). 'Ruins Zone' from QuestMess#0.60; quest title is 'Antlar Strikes Again'.

Quest009.bla (QuestEventMess009, same text): here TextIdOffset+N plays row N, no +1 shift (content confirms: +7 is the rough Ankh line, +9+pt fits the 15 voices). +6 Maganac (79), +7 Ankh (36), +8 Maganac, +9+pt leader block 9-23.
'Nakama' singular: the captive turns out to be Pigmon (later in quest 9), so 'one of our comrades'.

Block 9-23 order from Quest009 Pt_Chara_Check: Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Wing Zero, 00, Nu, Zeta, God, Rider 1, RX, Den-O, W, OOO (default). Wording confirms: 12 Mebius polite, 13 Zero cocky, 14 Heero 'ninmu ryoukai', 18 Domon, 21 Momotaros, 22 Shotaro, 23 OOO naming Ankh. 12 'them' = the unidentified captive.

Unreferenced in Quest009.bla; speaker inferred Maganac (polite request, map marker). 'Onegai shimasu' = Maganac asking the party -> 'We're counting on you.' Source writes MAP in capitals; rendered 'map'.
+31+pt block 31-45 (same order): 31-34 Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius. Reuses the established 'So that's it...!!'.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest008.bla (row = TextIdOffset+N+1) and Quest009.bla (row = TextIdOffset+N). Quest008: Crazygon 94, Ankh 98/118/120, leader block 99-113, 00 117/119/121/151/153, Maganac 146/148/149/152, narration 147, OkWins 115/165/166. Unreferenced, speakers inferred: 123, 126-139, 141, 155, 158-164 (alternate scenes). Quest009: Maganac 6/8 (24 inferred), Ankh 7, leader blocks 9-23 and 31-34. Item 'Broken O Raiser' coined from 'O Raiser' + the 'Broken X' item pattern. No new names.
